hero.headline: A medical doorway, opened gently across Xinjiang.
hero.subheadline: Capsule endoscopy, cardiac MR angiography, low-dose imaging, and care navigation for cross-border families, in one calm place.

section_meinian.title: Meinian Health · Xinjiang flagship
section_meinian.lead: Two procedures lead the year for our Xinjiang flagship team: a capsule endoscopy line and a cardiac MR angiography program.

section_science.title: Understand it first. Then decide.
section_science.lead: The Patient Library explains how each test works, what happens during it, and what to prepare, so you can ask your physician the right questions.

section_cross_border.title: From Central Asia to Xinjiang, the trip can be light.
section_cross_border.lead: From invitation letters and visa support to translators and follow-up calls, our Xinjiang team walks beside you in Chinese, Russian, and Uzbek.

final_cta.title: Share a few details. A care coordinator will reach you within one business day.
final_cta.body: Consultations are complimentary. Procedure fees follow the clinic's published schedule.

stat_contact: Care coordinator replies within 1 business day

section_capabilities.title: Three things we do for patients

cap_read.title: Understand first, then decide
cap_read.body: Plain-language explanations of each procedure, its workflow, and what to prepare, with cited sources and last-updated dates.

cap_book.title: Fast booking
cap_book.body: Submit the form, get a reply within one business day, and confirm your timing with Chinese, Russian, or Uzbek escort support.

cap_followup.title: Continuity after discharge
cap_followup.body: Back in Central Asia, continue with the same physician by video, and we help with Chinese-Russian translation of any medical documents.

pull_quote.body: We do not leave after the scan. We walk with patients from the clinic door, all the way home with their report, and on to their next follow-up.
